title: Hardcoded outdated LLM model IDs
description: Model identifiers (claude-3-5-sonnet, gemini-1.5-pro, etc.) are hardcoded in the codebase and have since been deprecated or surpassed.
mitigation: Centralize model registry; pull active models from a config table per provider with effective-date metadata.

title: No authentication on backend routes
description: All /api/* routes are unauthenticated; anyone with the URL can spend LLM tokens or trigger outbound tool calls.
mitigation: Add Fastify auth plugin gated on Microsoft EntraID JWT; reject anonymous requests; enforce ministry scoping via dynamic group claims.

title: No PII/secret detection before LLM call
description: User input is forwarded to third-party LLM providers without scanning for PII (SIN, health card, names) or secrets (API keys).
mitigation: Regex-driven PII detector in packages/backend/src/lib/pii.ts runs pre-flight; blocks or redacts before egress.

title: Open CORS / open hosting environment
description: Backend likely permits any origin; no production-grade WAF / IP allowlist.
mitigation: Restrict CORS to nexus.aim.* origins; deploy behind GoA load balancer with WAF rules.

title: SQL injection risk in db tool
description: /api/tools/db forwards user-supplied SQL to an external Postgres. If exposed to LLM tool-calls this is a confused-deputy vector.
mitigation: Parameterize queries; deny DDL/DML by default; require an allowlist of read-only queries per tool instance.

title: Unrestricted SSRF via api_call tool
description: api_call accepts arbitrary URLs; can reach internal services (169.254.169.254, RFC1918) from the backend pod.
mitigation: Block private IP ranges, metadata endpoints, and DNS rebinding; require URL allowlist per ministry.

title: Unrestricted SSRF via web_scrape tool
description: Same as api_call — scrape fetches arbitrary URLs server-side.
mitigation: DNS resolve and block private networks before fetch; size/time limits.

title: No audit logging for LLM calls
description: Prompts, tool calls, and responses are not persisted; cannot satisfy Protected B audit requirements.
mitigation: Append-only audit table audit_log with user, ministry, prompt hash, tools used, output classification.

title: API keys stored as plain env vars
description: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY etc. live in .env; no rotation, no per-ministry isolation.
mitigation: Pull from GoA secrets manager at boot; rotate quarterly; per-ministry keys where feasible.

title: No rate limiting on /api routes
description: No per-user or per-IP rate limits; LLM cost-exhaustion DoS is trivial.
mitigation: @fastify/rate-limit with per-user (EntraID OID) buckets.

title: Missing content security policy
description: Frontend has no CSP, weakening XSS defenses around streamed markdown.
mitigation: Add CSP meta with nonce-based script-src; restrict to self + nexus domains.

title: Markdown renders unsanitized model output
description: LLM outputs are rendered as markdown; HTML/JS injection through prompt injection is possible.
mitigation: Use vue-markdown-render with DOMPurify; disable raw HTML and javascript: URLs.

title: No session timeout / idle logout
description: Once authenticated the session has no enforced timeout.
mitigation: 30-minute idle timeout; absolute 8-hour cap.

title: No retention or purge policy
description: Free agent sessions, artifacts, and prompts persist indefinitely.
mitigation: Define retention windows per classification; nightly purge job; user export endpoint.

title: No data classification labels
description: Workflow runs have no Protected A/B classification; cross-ministry data leakage possible.
mitigation: Require classification on every run; route Protected B to vetted LLM endpoints only (Vertex).

title: Egress to third-party LLMs without proxy
description: Data leaves GoA boundary direct to api.anthropic.com / generativelanguage.googleapis.com.
mitigation: Route via GoA Vertex AI proxy for Protected A/B; document data residency.

title: Free agent loop has no max iteration cap visible
description: Iteration counter can grow unbounded; cost / loop-detection edge cases.
mitigation: Hard-cap iterations (e.g. 25) server-side; surface progress; abort signal.

title: Tool secrets stored in browser localStorage
description: SecretOverrides from SecretsMiniPanel persist in localStorage in cleartext.
mitigation: Move secret overrides server-side keyed by user; never localStorage for secrets.

title: No accessibility audit on canvas UI
description: Canvas-mode (xyflow) and modals lack keyboard navigation and ARIA labels in places.
mitigation: WCAG 2.1 AA pass; axe-core CI check.

title: No CSRF protection on state-changing routes
description: POST routes accept cross-origin via CORS without CSRF token validation.
mitigation: Double-submit cookie or SameSite=Lax + Origin/Referer check.

title: Mobile responsiveness gaps
description: Workflow canvas is desktop-first; mobile layout has been called out in source repo issues.
mitigation: Validate breakpoints; provide simple-view as mobile default.

title: Hardcoded Supabase URL in legacy source
description: Legacy React app retains supabase URLs; not in target build but cleanup item.
mitigation: Confirm no supabase reference leaked into target; CI grep guard.
